notes.text: J. Tavares is out and missed their last game. He is a top-six forward.
O. Ekman-Larsson has started killing penalties: on the ice for 28% of the team’s shorthanded time in 5 games, up from 6% last season.

UTA.head: This one sets up well for Utah
UTA.body: Utah has controlled the play far better over recent games, Toronto will be without Tavares, and Utah has home ice. Anything short of a win would be a surprise, though Toronto can make a game of it if they pounce on loose pucks.

TOR.head: Everything points away from Toronto
TOR.body: Utah has controlled the play far better over recent games, Toronto will be without Tavares, and Utah has home ice. Toronto could still pull it off if they pounce on loose pucks, but they might need a miracle.
